description: Every Datto RMM API operation, plus a local SQLite fleet store and fleet-wide analytics no other Datto tool has.

auth_env_var_specs.name: DATTO_RMM_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Datto RMM API key (username in the OAuth password grant). Generate in Setup > Users in the Datto RMM web UI.

auth_env_var_specs.name: DATTO_RMM_API_SECRET_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Datto RMM API secret key (password in the OAuth password grant).

auth_env_var_specs.name: DATTO_RMM_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Optional pre-minted OAuth bearer token (skips the auto-mint).

auth_description: Datto RMM mints a bearer token via OAuth2 password grant: POST {base}/auth/oauth/token with HTTP Basic public-client:public and grant_type=password, username=<API key>, password=<API secret key>. The CLI performs this exchange automatically and refreshes on 401. Set DATTO_RMM_API_KEY and DATTO_RMM_API_SECRET_KEY, and select your region via DATTO_RMM_PLATFORM (pinotage|merlot|concord|vidal|zinfandel|syrah) or DATTO_RMM_API_URL.

novel_features.name: Fleet staleness sweep
novel_features.description: Lists every device across all customer sites that hasn't checked in within a chosen window, so you catch dead agents before the customer does.

novel_features.name: Alert storm ranking
novel_features.description: Ranks the noisiest devices and sites by alert volume over a time window so the NOC can tune monitors instead of drowning in tickets.

novel_features.name: Patch-compliance gaps
novel_features.description: Ranks every device by missing-patch count across all sites so you remediate the most-exposed endpoints first.

novel_features.name: AV/security posture gaps
novel_features.description: Finds every device fleet-wide where antivirus is missing, disabled, or not running, so security gaps surface before an incident does.

novel_features.name: Software inventory rollup
novel_features.description: Rolls up audited software across the whole fleet to show how many installs of an app exist and the spread of versions, exposing license waste and unpatched copies.

novel_features.name: Warranty cliff
novel_features.description: Surfaces every device whose hardware warranty expires within a window, sorted by date and site, ready to drop into a QBR refresh plan.

novel_features.name: QBR site scorecard
novel_features.description: Produces a one-shot per-site health card fusing device counts, alert volume, patch coverage, AV coverage, warranty exposure, and agent drift for QBRs.

novel_features.name: Agent-version drift
novel_features.description: Shows which devices run out-of-date RMM agents across the fleet, ranked by how far behind the newest version they are.

novel_features.name: Ghost/orphan reconciliation
novel_features.description: Cross-references long-stale, suspended, or deleted devices that still count against a site so you stop billing and monitoring phantom endpoints.

novel_features.name: Alert-storm bulk resolve
novel_features.description: Bulk-resolves the open alerts on the noisiest devices and sites from the storm ranking, so Monday triage ends with a clean queue instead of a worklist.

novel_features.name: Quick-job result rollup
novel_features.description: Fetches every device's result for one quick job and rolls them into a single pass/fail table, so a 200-device push is verified in one command.

novel_features.name: Fleet snapshot receipt
novel_features.description: Freezes the current synced fleet state into a labeled, dated archive so any number you report can be reproduced later as a receipt.

novel_features.name: Fleet snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Diffs two fleet snapshots (or a snapshot vs the live store) to show devices added or removed and warranty, patch, AV, and agent-version movement since the baseline.

novel_features.name: Device timeline
novel_features.description: Stitches one device's alerts and activity-log entries (which surface job, audit, and user actions) into a single chronological timeline from the local store.

novel_features.name: Sync completeness check
novel_features.description: Verifies every synced resource pulled all pages by comparing stored row counts against the API's reported totals, so you can trust fleet numbers before reporting them.
